Alright, do you know how to use the inspector tool in your web browser?

The way it’s done on this sub is the headers are H5s and the contents of each box are in a blockquote, with the following CSS:

.side .md h5 {
 border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
 font-size: 100%;
 font-style: normal;
 line-height: 1.4;
 padding: 5px;
 text-align: center;
 margin: 10px 0 0;
}

.light .side .md h5 {
 background: #BDAEFF;
 background: -webkit-linear-gradient( top,#D2C8FF,#BDAEFF );
 background: -moz-linear-gradient( top,#D2C8FF,#BDAEFF );
 background: -ms-linear-gradient( top,#D2C8FF,#BDAEFF );
 background: -o-linear-gradient( top,#D2C8FF,#BDAEFF );
 border: 1px solid #A693FF;
 color: #382D6C;
}

.side .md h5 + blockquote {
 background: none;
 margin: 0 0 10px;
}

.light .side .md h5 + blockquote {
 border: 1px solid #A693FF;
 border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px;
}

But we could easily do that with the H1s in your sub. I would actually use .titlebox since .side is not unique to the content we want to style, so something like this:

.titlebox .md h1 {
 background: red;
}

and of course you can add padding, change the font size, centre the text etc as you wish.
